Saturday 7 Nov

Cajun Salmon with Herby Cauliflower Rice and Creamy Cucumber Salad

Fish35 min

Ingredients

Salmon
  • Skin-on salmon fillet440 g
  • Cajun spice8 g (3½ tsp)
  • Salt¼ tsp
  • Olive oil½ tbsp
Cauli rice
  • Olive oil½ tbsp
  • Cumin seeds3 g (1½ tsp)
  • Cauliflower380 g
  • Fresh parsley19 g
  • Fresh mint13 g
  • Lemon1
  • Salt½ tsp
  • Sun-dried tomatoes40 g
Cucumber salad
  • Cucumber1
  • Fresh dill19 g
  • Natural yogurt210 g
  • Salt¼ tsp
  • Black pepper½ tsp

Method

  1. Prep. Thinly slice the cucumber. Roughly chop the sun-dried tomatoes, dill, parsley and mint. Zest the lemon.
  2. Make cauli rice. Grate or blitz the cauliflower until it looks like rice grains. Heat a little oil in a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat, fry the cumin seeds 1 min, add the cauliflower with salt and pepper and fry 5–7 min until tender. Cover to keep warm.
  3. Cook salmon. Cut into portions, sprinkle all over with the cajun spice (spicy) and a pinch of salt. Fry skin-side down in a little oil over medium-high heat 3–4 min, flip and cook 3–4 min more until cooked through. Or bake at 200°C (180°C fan) for 10–12 min.
  4. Finish cauli rice. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes, parsley, half the mint and half the lemon zest. Cover to keep warm.
  5. Prepare salad. Mix the cucumber, dill, yogurt, remaining mint and lemon zest with a pinch of salt and pepper.
  6. Serve the cauli rice topped with the salmon and a spoonful of cucumber salad, with a squeeze of lemon.

Mint darkens with heat, so add it to the cauli rice just before serving. Today is also the mushroom miso cube batch: see the Notion page Flavour cubes.

Sunday 8 Nov

Pasta alla Montecarlo (creamy beef and pesto pasta), for 7

PastaServes 7

Ingredients

Amounts already scaled for 7 people
  • Short pasta560 g
  • Minced beef420 g
  • Tomato paste21 ml (about 1½ tbsp)
  • Basil pesto70 g
  • Cooking cream350 g
  • White onion, chopped¾
  • Black pepper, dried oregano, salt, olive oilas needed

Method

  1. Soffritto. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large pan, add the chopped onion and let it soften over medium heat.
  2. Brown the meat. Add the minced beef and cook until nicely browned. Season with salt, pepper and a pinch of dried oregano.
  3. Add the tomato paste. Stir it in and mix well.
  4. Make the creamy sauce. Lower the heat, pour in the cream and the pesto. Stir continuously until smooth, rich and creamy. Adjust salt and pepper.
  5. Cook the pasta. Boil the pasta in a large pot of salted water until al dente, following the packet.
  6. Combine. Drain the pasta and transfer it straight into the pan with the sauce. Toss for a minute to coat it. Serve with a sprinkle of Parmesan if you like.

With this much pasta, use your biggest pan, or mix pasta and sauce in the pasta pot.

Monday 9 Nov

Crispy Parmesan Chicken with Vegetables and Caper Mayo

Chicken30 min

Ingredients

Chicken
  • Chicken breast500 g
  • Salt½ tsp
  • Black pepper½ tsp
  • Parmesan40 g
  • Egg1
  • Panko breadcrumbs25 g
  • Vegetable oil2½ tbsp
Vegetables
  • Green beans190 g
  • Small zucchini2½
  • Red pepper1
  • Olive oil1¼ tbsp
  • Salt½ tsp
  • Dried basil3 g (about 2¼ tsp)
Caper mayo
  • Capers25 g (about 2¾ tbsp)
  • Mayonnaise65 g (4½ tbsp)

Method

  1. Coat chicken. Pat the chicken dry and slice each breast in half horizontally into two thin escalopes. Season well. Finely grate the Parmesan and mix with the panko on a plate. Beat the egg in a bowl. Dip the chicken in egg, then coat in the Parmesan crumbs.
  2. Prep vegetables. Trim the green beans, cut the zucchini into half moons, deseed and chop the red pepper.
  3. Make caper mayo. Finely chop the capers and mix with the mayonnaise.
  4. Fry chicken. Fry in batches in a generous drizzle of oil over medium-high heat, 3–4 min each side, until golden and cooked through.
  5. Stir-fry vegetables. In another pan, fry the green beans and pepper with a pinch of salt for 3–4 min. Add a splash of water, then the zucchini and dried basil; fry 2 min more and season.
  6. Serve the vegetables topped with the crispy chicken and the caper mayo on the side.

Alternatively, bake the breaded chicken on a lined tray, drizzled with oil, at 200°C (180°C fan) for 12–15 min.

Tuesday 10 Nov

Spicy Bean and Corn Enchiladas with Mozzarella and Guacamole

Vegetarian30 min

Ingredients

Enchiladas
  • Red onion1
  • Garlic3 cloves
  • Sweet corn kernels180 g
  • Red kidney beans300 g
  • Vegetable oil1¼ tbsp
  • Salt½ tsp
  • Chipotle powder3 g (1¼ tsp)
  • Smoked paprika3 g (1¼ tsp)
  • Coriander-cumin powder5 g (2 tsp)
  • Tomato passata250 g (about 1 cup)
  • Vegetable stock cube1
  • Brown sugar13 g (1 tbsp, packed)
  • Black pepper½ tsp
  • Wholewheat tortilla wraps5
  • Mild tomato salsa75 g (about 5 tbsp)
  • Grated mozzarella110 g
Guacamole
  • Fresh coriander19 g
  • Avocado1
  • Lime1
  • Salt½ tsp

Method

  1. Prep filling. Preheat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Finely chop the onion, mince the garlic, drain and rinse the corn and kidney beans.
  2. Cook filling. Fry the onion in oil over medium-high heat with a pinch of salt for 5 min. Add the garlic, chipotle (spicy), smoked paprika and coriander-cumin powder; cook 2 min.
  3. Simmer. Add the corn, beans, passata, half the stock cube, the brown sugar and a splash of water. Simmer 5 min until thick. Season.
  4. Fill and bake. Divide the filling between the wraps, roll up and lay seam-side down in an oiled dish. Top with the salsa and mozzarella and bake 10 min until golden.
  5. Make guacamole. Finely chop the coriander. Mash the avocado with a squeeze of lime until smooth, add most of the coriander and season well.
  6. Serve the enchiladas with the guacamole, garnished with the remaining coriander.

Sensitive to spice? Go easy on the chipotle.

Wednesday 11 Nov

Classic Braised Beef Bourguignon with Mashed Potatoes

Red meat55 min

Ingredients

Bourguignon
  • Steak strips440 g
  • Carrot1
  • Mushrooms310 g
  • White onion1
  • Garlic3 cloves
  • Salt½ tsp
  • Black pepper¼ tsp
  • Plain flour19 g (2½ tbsp)
  • Vegetable oil1¼ tbsp
  • Dried bay leaf1
  • Tomato paste40 g (2¾ tbsp)
  • Water440 ml (about 1¾ cups)
  • Balsamic vinegar19 ml (1¼ tbsp)
  • Brown sugar6 g (1¼ tsp, packed)
  • Beef stock cube1
  • Fresh thyme13 g
  • Fresh parsley19 g
Potato mash
  • Potatoes750 g
  • Salt1¼ tsp
  • Butter13 g
  • Black pepper½ tsp

Method

  1. Prep. Chop the carrots into small bite-sized pieces. Wipe and chop the mushrooms. Finely chop the garlic and half the onion.
  2. Prep beef. Pat the steak strips very dry, season with salt and pepper and toss in the flour.
  3. Fry beef. Heat a large pot over high heat with oil. Fry the beef in small batches for 2–3 min until deeply browned. Set aside and keep the pot.
  4. Make stew. Add more oil, the mushrooms, onion and carrots with a pinch of salt; fry 5 min until browned. Add the garlic, bay leaf and tomato paste; fry 1 min. Return the beef with the water, balsamic, brown sugar, stock cube and thyme (half or all, to taste). Simmer, covered, on medium for 30–35 min until tender.
  5. Make mash. Peel and chop the potatoes; boil in salted water for 20 min until soft. Drain, mash with butter, season.
  6. Serve. Stir chopped parsley into the stew and serve on the mash.

The pot must be really hot before the beef goes in, or it stews instead of browning. Add a splash of water if the stew reduces too fast.

Thursday 12 Nov

Minestrone Soup with Chicken

SoupAbout 45 min1 mirepoix cube

Ingredients

Soup
  • Cannellini beans, tinned1 cup
  • Chicken legs3
  • Zucchini1
  • Green beans1 handful
  • Crushed tomatoes1 quart (about 950 ml)
  • Chicken bone broth2 cups (about 480 ml)
  • Mirepoix cube, from the freezer1
  • Olive oil, salt, pepper, fresh herbs to finish

Method

  1. Pan-fry the chicken legs in olive oil over medium-high heat until browned. Remove from the pan.
  2. Chop the vegetables into bite-sized pieces and sauté in the chicken fat with salt and pepper, about 3 min until slightly browned.
  3. Add the mirepoix cube, chicken legs, beans, tomatoes and broth; season.
  4. Cover and simmer 30 min, until slightly reduced and the chicken comes off the bone.
  5. Remove the bones, check the seasoning and finish with fresh herbs.
